sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: UN anti-impunity commission created
geopolitical_news.summary: December pact with the UN creates CICIG to fight organized crime and entrenched corruption in a landmark deal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Berger's final year
geopolitical_news.summary: Outgoing president Berger touts economic stability as November elections approach, with crime the top concern for voters.

sport.headline: World Cup dream dies early
sport.summary: Guatemala falls short in CONCACAF qualifying for the Germany World Cup, exiting in the semifinal round.

geopolitical_news.headline: Colom wins the presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: November runoff gives the UNE candidate victory over Pérez Molina on promises to fight poverty and crime.

geopolitical_news.headline: Salvadoran politicians murdered
geopolitical_news.summary: February killing of three Central American parliament deputies shocks the region, exposing police-criminal links in a major scandal.

sport.headline: Gold Cup quarterfinal run
sport.summary: Guatemala reaches the knockout stage in June before falling to Canada in a narrow defeat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Colom takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: January inauguration brings a social-democrat agenda and high hopes amid gang violence and entrenched poverty.

geopolitical_news.headline: CICIG begins work
geopolitical_news.summary: The UN anti-impunity commission opens investigations into clandestine criminal networks in its first year.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying failure
sport.summary: Guatemala exits 2010 World Cup qualifying in the third round, missing the final hexagonal once again.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rosenberg murder scandal
geopolitical_news.summary: A lawyer's videotaped accusation against the president in May triggers a political crisis before investigators debunk it.

geopolitical_news.headline: CICIG clears Colom
geopolitical_news.summary: The UN commission finds the president innocent in the Rosenberg case in its landmark investigation.

sport.headline: Gold Cup group-stage exit
sport.summary: Guatemala fails to advance at the 2009 Gold Cup in July after a winless campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Storm Agatha and Pacaya eruption
geopolitical_news.summary: May's volcanic eruption and tropical storm kill dozens and wreck infrastructure in the year's worst disaster.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug violence spreads
geopolitical_news.summary: Mexican cartels push into Guatemala, corrupting police and officials as the drug corridor shifts south.

sport.headline: Medals at the CAC Games
sport.summary: Guatemalan athletes win medals at July's Central American and Caribbean Games in Puerto Rico.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pérez Molina wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory brings a former general to power on security promises, defeating Baldizón in a runoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: CICIG's mandate extended
geopolitical_news.summary: The UN commission wins more time amid political resistance in Guatemala City as it jails crime bosses.

sport.headline: Gold Cup quarterfinal again
sport.summary: Guatemala reaches the last eight in June before losing to Mexico in a hard-fought match.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pérez Molina's mano dura
geopolitical_news.summary: New president deploys troops against gangs and drug traffickers in January, with mixed results.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ríos Montt genocide case advances
geopolitical_news.summary: Ex-dictator Ríos Montt is ordered to face trial for 1980s atrocities in a historic ruling.

sport.headline: Barrondo wins historic silver
sport.summary: Erick Barrondo takes 20km walk silver in August at the London Games, Guatemala's first Olympic medal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ríos Montt convicted, then freed
geopolitical_news.summary: May genocide conviction is overturned days later on procedural grounds, outraging victims' families and human rights groups.

geopolitical_news.headline: Customs corruption exposed
geopolitical_news.summary: CICIG investigations begin unraveling the La Línea customs corruption network that will topple a president two years later.

sport.headline: Quiet year for Guatemalan sport
sport.summary: Athletes medal across several disciplines at the Central American Games in San José in March.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug trafficking deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Cartels tighten their grip with record cocaine seizures along trafficking routes as the state struggles to respond.

geopolitical_news.headline: Child migrant crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Thousands of unaccompanied Guatemalan minors surge toward the US border in a summer humanitarian crisis straining shelters.

sport.headline: CAC Games medals in Veracruz
sport.summary: Guatemala's athletes win medals in November at the regional games in Mexico across athletics and racquet sports.

geopolitical_news.headline: La Línea scandal erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: April revelations expose a customs bribery ring run by top officials, reaching the presidency and investigated by CICIG.

geopolitical_news.headline: President resigns and is jailed
geopolitical_news.summary: Pérez Molina quits in September after mass street protests demanding his ouster and is jailed over corruption.

geopolitical_news.headline: Outsider Morales wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: Comedian Jimmy Morales sweeps October elections on an anti-corruption wave, defeating Torres in a runoff.

sport.headline: Cordón's badminton gold in Toronto
sport.summary: Kevin Cordón wins Pan Am badminton gold in July at the Toronto Games, defending his 2011 title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: January inauguration brings promises of honesty and a new era after his surprise victory over the establishment.

geopolitical_news.headline: CICIG targets the president's circle
geopolitical_news.summary: UN investigators close in on the president's family and party finances, straining the relationship with the commission.

sport.headline: FIFA suspends Guatemala
sport.summary: October suspension over governance failures bans teams from international play amid federation corruption probes and government interference.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hogar Seguro fire kills 41
geopolitical_news.summary: March blaze at a state shelter kills 41 girls, exposing abuse and sparking national outrage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales moves against CICIG
geopolitical_news.summary: August bid to expel the UN commissioner triggers a constitutional crisis as courts block him.

sport.headline: Ban sidelines Guatemalan football
sport.summary: The FIFA suspension keeps teams out of World Cup qualifying throughout the year, stalling the national program.

geopolitical_news.headline: CICIG's mandate terminated
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales refuses to renew the UN commission in a blow to anti-corruption efforts, ending its 12-year run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Migrant caravans head north
geopolitical_news.summary: October caravans of Hondurans and Guatemalans march toward the US, drawing Trump's ire and border crackdowns.

sport.headline: FIFA lifts the suspension
sport.summary: A May decision readmits Guatemala to international football after governance reforms, ending an 18-month exile.

geopolitical_news.headline: Giammattei wins the presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: August runoff victory brings a hardline conservative to power over Torres amid low turnout.

geopolitical_news.headline: Safe third country deal with US
geopolitical_news.summary: July pact forces asylum seekers to claim refuge in Guatemala despite domestic opposition and court challenges.

sport.headline: Return to international football
sport.summary: Guatemala rejoins CONCACAF competitions in September after the long FIFA ban, starting in the Nations League.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pandemic and hurricanes batter Guatemala
geopolitical_news.summary: COVID-19 strains hospitals before Eta and Iota strike in November, displacing thousands in the year's twin disasters.

geopolitical_news.headline: Giammattei's rocky first year
geopolitical_news.summary: Corruption allegations and a struggling response dog the new president amid congressional battles over the budget.

sport.headline: Football halted by COVID
sport.summary: The pandemic suspends Guatemala's leagues and national team fixtures in March for most of the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Protests against Giammattei
geopolitical_news.summary: Street demonstrations in the capital denounce corruption and the government's pandemic response through the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Harris visits Guatemala
geopolitical_news.summary: The US vice president's June visit presses Guatemala on corruption and migration with stern warnings against traveling north.

sport.headline: Comunicaciones wins CONCACAF League
sport.summary: The club beats Motagua in December for Guatemala's first regional title in a historic triumph.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anti-corruption exodus
geopolitical_news.summary: Prosecutors and judges flee as Giammattei's allies capture the courts, dismantling CICIG's legacy case by case.

geopolitical_news.headline: Top journalist jailed
geopolitical_news.summary: July arrest of elPeriódico's founder deepens a crackdown on the press, drawing international condemnation.

sport.headline: Rebuild under coach Tena
sport.summary: Luis Fernando Tena takes over a national team in transition as Guatemala eyes the 2026 World Cup cycle.

geopolitical_news.headline: Arévalo's surprise victory
geopolitical_news.summary: Anti-corruption candidate Bernardo Arévalo wins the August runoff, stunning the establishment despite legal attacks on his candidacy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Prosecutors target the winners
geopolitical_news.summary: The attorney general moves to annul results in the fall, sparking mass protests in defense of democracy.

sport.headline: Gold Cup quarterfinal run
sport.summary: Guatemala reaches the last eight in July before falling to Jamaica in Cincinnati.

geopolitical_news.headline: Arévalo takes office amid coup fears
geopolitical_news.summary: January inauguration survives prosecutors' bid to block the transfer of power in a tense ceremony.

geopolitical_news.headline: President battles the old guard
geopolitical_news.summary: Arévalo battles entrenched prosecutors while pushing anti-corruption reforms through a difficult first year in office.

sport.headline: First Olympic gold for Guatemala
sport.summary: Adriana Ruano wins trap shooting gold in August; Brol takes bronze in Paris in a historic double.

geopolitical_news.headline: Arévalo's reform push stalls
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress blocks key reforms in his second year as the president's approval slides amid elite resistance.

geopolitical_news.headline: US deportations strain ties
geopolitical_news.summary: A surge in US deportation flights in 2025 tests Guatemala's reception capacity and bilateral relations.

sport.headline: Historic Gold Cup semifinal
sport.summary: Guatemala reaches the last four in July, falling 2-1 to the US.
